title: 第 10 章
slug: 暴君的炮灰男后穿书全本免费-暴君的炮灰男后穿书最新章节列表
content_zh:
薛遥点开按钮，一排食物立体投影出现在他面前，从左往右分别是一颗西瓜、一盘成品龙虾盖浇饭、两斤荔枝、一盒生鸡蛋、一块八寸芝士蛋糕。
当他用手指选中西瓜时，界面弹出兑换按钮，按钮上方显示所需洗白点：1点。
又试着点开其他四种食品，不知是巧合还是统一价格，兑换所需点数都是1点。
因为刚跟老太太吃过晚饭，薛遥对食物的抵抗力十足，所以没忙着兑换，而是寻找界面上的其他提示。
难道只有这五种食品能兑换吗？还是说某个时间段会刷新物品？
很快，他在兑换界面的右下角看见了一个刷新按钮，按钮旁有问号图案。
点开问号，弹出一个对话框说明：
欢迎光临三级食品商城，选中食品可自主兑换，向上滑动可刷新商城，三级商城每日可刷新次数为3次。
开启二级食品商城，每日可刷新次数将提升为300次。
开启一级食品商城，宿主可自主搜索食品进行兑换。
怎么没说明如何升级食品商城？
会不会是魔方的第二层方格？
薛遥关闭兑换界面，点了一下方格上一层的方格，巨大的魔方闪烁了一下，弹出提示——
开启二级食品商城条件：
①消耗150洗白点。
②完成主线任务一：打通陆潜的任督二脉。
“……”薛遥震惊了！
升级商城消耗150点洗白点他是能接受的，毕竟知道剧情，救人命都不算太难。
但打通陆潜的任督二脉是什么鬼！要他暴揍男主吗？这等于是自杀！
这本《只手遮天》是典型地龙傲天小说，剧情不止涉及朝政党争、后宫种马，作者为了凑字数，还写到主角的习武之路，男主最终的武力值不怂金庸老爷子笔下任何一位高人。

而他练武的开端，就是要打通任督二脉。
原著中，男主的任督二脉是被三皇子打通的。
地点：习武场。
男主年幼时初次参加训练，被三皇子“不小心”踢中腹部，踹飞出去，摔晕了。
本以为会身负内伤，没想到一觉睡醒屁事没有，甚至开启了武学天赋。
从旁观者看来，三皇子这一脚算是帮了男主，男主逆袭归来后也没忘了这命运的一脚，分分钟就把三皇子踢他的那一只脚用剑贯穿脚背，钉在了地上。
而现在，系统把打通男主任督二脉的光荣任务，交给了薛遥。
薛遥吞咽了一口，擦掉额头的冷汗，做出了一个明智的决定：大不了就不升级商城了，一辈子用最低级商城也挺好，一天能刷新三次呢，美滋滋。
做个不贪心的炮灰，才能保住耳朵尾巴和脚脚！
然而他还是低估了系统的无耻程度。
成为七皇子伴读的第一天，见面那一刻，薛遥脑中响起系统提示：主线任务已开启。
薛遥：“……”
什么主线？
什么任务？
解释清楚！
接下来并没有听见任何提示。
这个系统比较佛系，一切随缘，剧情自然进行到某一步时才会有新的提示。
不见棺材不落泪的薛遥决定走一步算一步，面色如常地给七皇子和汐妃请安。
七皇子胖嘟嘟的小脸没有表情，目光直直看着薛遥。
“以后他就是你的新伴读。”汐妃娘娘亲自给儿子引荐。

薛遥立即回道：“小人名叫薛遥，殿下可以唤我阿遥。”
七皇子仍旧面无表情，也不回答。
汐妃以为孩子怕生，没有多想，转头吩咐内侍准备车舆，送两个孩子去学堂。
一直面无表情地七皇子，抓准母妃视线移开的瞬间，对薛遥吐出小舌尖！
薛遥：“？”
汐妃吩咐完回过头，七皇子警觉的收回了自己的小舌尖，恢复面无表情。
薛遥：“……”刚刚一定是看花眼了吧？
然而，当汐妃再次移开视线时，七皇子仿佛装了智能探测仪一般，再次对薛遥吐出小舌尖，并抬起小胖手，一扒自己左眼的下眼皮……
薛遥看出来了。
这小家伙在对他做鬼脸。
趁母妃不注意的时候。
真的特别狡猾了！
是在记恨骑马的事情吧！
男主果然是记仇狂魔！
即使修好了小木马都未必能保住耳朵和尾巴啊！
薛遥劝自己冷静，以德服人，对七皇子露出一个包容的微笑。
七皇子抬起另一只小胖手，用指尖顶起自己的鼻尖，变本加厉地对他做了个“猪鼻子鬼脸”。
薛遥：“……”
原著中的男主明明是个高冷面瘫多智近妖的腹黑美男。
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢暴君的炮灰男后[穿书]请大家
content_en:
Xue Yao clicked on the button, and a row of food stereoscopic projections appeared in front of him. From left to right were a watermelon, a plate of finished lobster rice bowl, two kilograms of lychees, a box of raw eggs, and an eight-inch cheesecake.
When he selected the watermelon with his finger, a redemption button popped up on the interface, and the required whitewashing point was displayed above the button: 1 point.
I also tried to order four other foods. I don’t know whether it was a coincidence or the same price, but the points required for redemption were all 1 point.
Because he had just had dinner with the old lady, Xue Yao was very resistant to food, so he was not busy redeeming it, but looked for other prompts on the interface.
Are these five foods the only ones that can be redeemed? Or do you mean that items will be refreshed during a certain period of time?
Soon, he saw a refresh button in the lower right corner of the redemption interface, with a question mark next to the button.
Click on the question mark and a dialog box will pop up stating:
Welcome to the third-level food mall. Selected food can be redeemed independently. Swipe up to refresh the mall. The third-level mall can be refreshed three times a day.
When the secondary food mall is opened, the number of refreshes per day will be increased to 300.
Open the first-level food mall, and the host can independently search for food and redeem it.
Why didn't you explain how to upgrade the food mall?
Could it be the second layer of the Rubik's Cube?
Xue Yao closed the exchange interface and clicked on the square above the square. The huge Rubik's Cube flashed and a prompt popped up——
Conditions for opening a secondary food mall:
① Consume 150 whitewash points.
②Complete the main mission 1: Open up Lu Qian’s Ren and Du lineage.
"..." Xue Yao was shocked!
He could accept the cost of 150 whitewash points to upgrade the mall. After all, he knew the plot and it was not too difficult to save lives.
But what the hell is the second line of Ren and Du that opened up Lu Qian! Do you want him to beat up the hero? This is tantamount to suicide!
This book "Covering the Sky with One Hand" is a typical novel by Long Aotian. The plot not only involves political strife and harem stallions. In order to make up for the word count, the author also writes about the protagonist's martial arts journey. The hero's final martial arts is not worth any of the masters written by Jin Yong.
The beginning of his martial arts training was to open up the Ren and Du channels.
In the original work, the male protagonist's second line of Ren and Du was opened by the third prince.
Location: Martial Arts Field.
When the male protagonist participated in training for the first time when he was young, he was "accidentally" kicked in the abdomen by the third prince, kicked out, and fell unconscious.
I thought I would suffer internal injuries, but I didn't expect that when I woke up, nothing happened, and my martial arts talent was even activated.
From the onlookers' point of view, the third prince's kick was regarded as helping the male protagonist. After the male protagonist returned from the counterattack, he did not forget this fateful kick. In a few minutes, the third prince kicked his foot with a sword through the instep and nailed it to the ground.
Now, the system has given Xue Yao the glorious task of opening up the male director's second line.
Xue Yao swallowed, wiped the cold sweat from his forehead, and made a wise decision: at worst, he would not upgrade the mall. It would be good to use the lowest level mall for the rest of his life. It was nice to be able to refresh it three times a day.
Only by being a non-greedy cannon fodder can you keep your ears, tail, and feet!
Yet he underestimated the shamelessness of the system.
On the first day when he became the companion of the Seventh Prince, the moment they met, a system prompt sounded in Xue Yao's mind: The main mission has been started.
Xue Yao: "..."
What main line?
What task?
Explain clearly!
No prompts were heard next.
This system is more Buddhist-style, everything is left to chance, and new prompts will appear only when the plot reaches a certain point.
Xue Yao, who could not shed tears without seeing the coffin, decided to take it one step at a time and greeted the Seventh Prince and Concubine Xi with a normal expression.
The seventh prince's chubby little face was expressionless, and he looked straight at Xue Yao.
"He will be your new companion from now on." Concubine Xi personally introduced her son.
Xue Yao immediately replied: "The villain's name is Xue Yao, your highness can call me Ayao."
The seventh prince remained expressionless and did not answer.
Concubine Xi thought the child was afraid of life, so she didn't think much about it and turned around to tell her concubineThe waiter prepared a carriage and sent the two children to school.
The seventh prince, who had always been expressionless, caught the moment his mother-in-law looked away and stuck out his tongue at Xue Yao!
Xue Yao: "?"
Concubine Xi turned around after giving her instructions. The seventh prince retracted the tip of his tongue alertly and returned to his expressionless face.
Xue Yao: "..." You must have been blinded just now, right?
However, when Concubine Xi looked away again, the Seventh Prince, as if equipped with a smart detector, once again stuck out the tip of his tongue at Xue Yao, raised his chubby hand, and touched the lower eyelid of his left eye...
Xue Yao saw it.
The little guy was making faces at him.
When the mother-in-law is not paying attention.
Really cunning!
He must be remembering the horse riding thing!
The male protagonist is indeed a vengeful maniac!
Even if you repair the little wooden horse, you may not be able to save its ears and tail!
Xue Yao persuaded himself to calm down, convince others with virtue, and showed an inclusive smile to the seventh prince.
The seventh prince raised his other chubby hand, raised the tip of his nose with his fingertips, and made an even more serious "pig-nosed face" at him.
Xue Yao: "..."
The male protagonist in the original work is obviously a cold-faced, dark-faced and handsome man who is almost as intelligent as a monster.
Little Master, there will be more after this chapter ^.^, please click on the next page to continue. The cannon-fodder male queen who likes tyrants [through the book] please everyone
